comparisons.summary: The captions differ on an ABV coefficient (135 versus 131.25). This is a candidate transcription conflict requiring audio review, not a confirmed disagreement in brewing advice.
Their February 2026 statement that they had not used chemical stabilizers predates the August 2026 experiment. Preserve both as a change in experience, not simultaneous contradictory advice.

followup_comparison.summary: The creator links the avocado follow-up to the original recipe. The original uses avocado honey, water and 71B; the follow-up reports stable fermented gravity, then adds spices and later sweetens. The follow-up’s tasting notes concern that changed batch, not an unchanged replication.
